title: Release workflow: wider PR paths, numeric macOS build name, flutter-action stays at @v2
context: The pipeline reviewer found four problems:U+000AU+002D The PR paths filter left out the code that all three builds compile: third_party/camera_macos, packages/sync_protocol, shaders and assets.U+000AU+002D Flutter strips non-digits from a macOS --build-name, so v1.2.0-beta.1 would become 1.2.0.1.U+000AU+002D Raw secrets were written to key.properties, where a backslash is an escape character.U+000AU+002D The release notes did not mention that the first release APK cannot install over a debug-signed one.U+000ASeparately, lane 13 suggested pinning subosito/flutter-action to a commit SHA.
options: Add third_party/**, packages/**, shaders/** and assets/** to the paths
Give macOS the numeric core ${version%%-*} as build_name, or document the stripping
Pin subosito/flutter-action to a SHA now, or leave @v2 to match goldens.yml and recommend it in the PR
outcome: Committed as release-pipeline 95145a16:U+000AU+002D The four paths are added.U+000AU+002D The version step also writes build_name=${version%%-*}, and only the macOS tagged build uses it.U+000AU+002D Secrets pass through a sed escape that doubles backslashes.U+000AU+002D The Android release notes tell users to uninstall earlier non-release builds.U+000Aflutter-action stays at @v2 to match the repository's existing workflows; the PR body recommends pinning it before the signing secrets are added. Spec 7.20 and 7.21 still state 8 paths and the full version as the build name, and the PR must say so. The spec was not edited, because mitosis checks the spec for drift on resume.
